name: HH
title: Appalling experience
text: Appalling experience. They took our money, cancelled the booking and promised a refund in 3 months time. The live chat was just an AI with generic “sorry for your experience” responses. No way to get through to a human. Most positive reviews here look AI generated. Family holiday ruined. DO NOT USE.

name: Elizabeth MacDonald
title: Price scam
text: I booked with a great price and answered all the confirmation questions in the right timeframe but then got a pop-up that one of my flights was "no longer available" and the alternatives didn't work for me... so I apparently wasn't charged the bokking and when I re-launched the search the flight I previously selected was suddenly available again at a higher price. Felt very sketchy and predatory.

title: Difference beween announced price and paid price
text: I booked a flight ticket through Bravofly company from Dubai to Amman (Booking ID: 2948290842). The displayed price at the time of booking was AED 993, and I was asked to pay an additional AED 20 as a Visa fee, making the total amount AED 1,013.However, the amount charged to my card was significantly higher—AED 1,260.Why is there a discrepancy of over AED 200 between the advertised price and the charged amount?Is this kind of practice considered professional on your part?
